_about: Default email templates for account and usage notices. Generated from the textbee-admin source of truth (api/src/email-templates/defaults.json); do not edit by hand. An admin edit is stored in the emailtemplates collection and overrides these fields; a missing row means the default applies.

footers.name: Notice footer (account and usage, branded)
footers.body:
This is a notice about your textbee account. If something in it looks wrong, you can reply to this email.

[Dashboard](https://app.textbee.dev/dashboard) · [Docs](https://textbee.dev/docs)

templates.name: Verify email
templates.subject: Confirm your email for textbee
templates.body:
# Confirm your email address

Hi,

One click confirms this address and unlocks sending.

**[Confirm my email]({{verificationUrl}})**

The link works for {{linkTtl}}. If it has expired, sign in. Your dashboard has a "Resend email" button.

If you did not create a textbee account, you can ignore this email.
templates.notes: No name in the greeting: the address is not verified yet, and bots put spam in the name field.

templates.name: Verification reminder
templates.subject: Your textbee email is not confirmed yet
templates.preheader: Sending is locked until you confirm. Here is a new link.
templates.body:
# Confirm your email to start sending

Hi,

Your textbee account is ready, but sending and receiving stay locked until you confirm this address. The earlier link has expired, so here is a new one:

**[Confirm my email]({{verificationUrl}})**

This link works for {{linkTtl}}.

If you signed up by mistake, you do not need to do anything. The account stays inactive.
templates.audience: Password signups still unverified after 24 h
templates.notes: Built as an API job that reuses the verification mint function with a 24 h link lifetime; it must not count against the 5-per-24h resend cap.

templates.name: Password reset request
templates.subject: Reset your textbee password
templates.preheader: Button or code. Both work for {{linkTtl}}.
templates.body:
# Reset your password

Hi {{firstName}},

We received a request to reset the password on your textbee account. You can choose a new one here.

**[Set a new password]({{resetUrl}})**

Or enter this code: **{{otp}}**

The button and the code work for {{linkTtl}}.

If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.

templates.name: Password changed
templates.subject: Your textbee password was changed
templates.preheader: Not you? A reply to this email reaches our support team.
templates.body:
# Your password was changed

Hi {{firstName}},

Your textbee password has been changed. You can sign in with the new password now.

**Not you?** If you did not make this change, reply to this email right away. We will secure your account.

templates.name: Close to the 30-day limit

templates.preheader: When it runs out, textbee rejects your messages. Upgrade before it stops.
templates.body:
# Your 30-day allowance is almost used

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used {{used}} of its {{limit}} messages in the last 30 days. When the last {{left}} are used, textbee rejects every message your app sends, and room comes back only as older messages pass 30 days.

{{usageBar}}

Upgrade now so sending does not stop. Pro gives you {{proMonthlyLimit}} messages per rolling 30 days, no daily limit, and up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones.

**[Upgrade to Pro]({{upgradeUrl}})**

{{proPrice}} a month, or {{proYearlyPrice}} a year ({{proYearlyMonthly}} a month). Cancel any time from the billing page.

templates.body:
# Sending has stopped on your account

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used all {{limit}} messages in its rolling 30-day allowance. textbee now rejects every message your app sends.

{{usageBar}}

Pro raises your allowance from {{limit}} to {{proMonthlyLimit}} messages per rolling 30 days, removes the daily limit, and covers up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones. Sending resumes as soon as the payment is complete.

**[Upgrade to Pro and resume sending]({{upgradeUrl}})**

{{proPrice}} a month, or {{proYearlyPrice}} a year ({{proYearlyMonthly}} a month). Cancel any time from the billing page.

Without an upgrade, room comes back slowly as older messages pass 30 days. The next message slot opens on {{resetDate}}.

templates.preheader: After that, textbee rejects your messages until midnight UTC.
templates.body:
# You are about to hit today's limit

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used {{used}} of its {{limit}} messages today. After {{left}} more, textbee stops sending until midnight UTC, and every message your app sends in the meantime is rejected.

{{usageBar}}

Pro has no daily limit. Upgrade now and sending never stops at {{limit}} again.

**[Upgrade to Pro]({{upgradeUrl}})**

Pro: {{proMonthlyLimit}} messages per rolling 30 days, no daily limit, up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones. {{proPrice}} a month, or {{proYearlyPrice}} a year ({{proYearlyMonthly}} a month).

Hi {{firstName}},

Your account used all {{limit}} of today's messages. textbee now rejects every message your app sends, until midnight UTC{{#localMidnight}} ({{localMidnight}} where you are){{/localMidnight}}.

templates.name: Batch not sent
templates.subject: Your batch was not sent
templates.preheader: Nothing was sent. Here is what fits.
templates.body:
# Your batch was not sent

Hi {{firstName}},

{{#bulkLimit}}Your batch had {{attempted}} recipients, and your plan allows up to {{bulkLimit}} per batch. Nothing was sent.

You can send the same list in batches of {{bulkLimit}} or fewer. Smaller batches cost nothing extra. They also do not slow delivery, because your phone sends one message at a time.{{/bulkLimit}}{{#roomLeft}}Your batch had {{attempted}} recipients, but your account has {{roomLeft}} {{roomWindow}}. Nothing was sent.

You can send a smaller batch now, or send the full batch after {{roomResetNote}}.{{/roomLeft}}

Pro has no batch limit and no daily limit, so the whole list goes out in one request.

**[Upgrade to Pro]({{upgradeUrl}})**
templates.trigger: A batch is refused: larger than the batch limit, or larger than the room left today or in the last 30 days
templates.notes: Two versions in one template. Batch-size refusal sets bulkLimit and leaves roomLeft empty. A batch that does not fit the room left sets roomLeft (for example "1 message"), roomWindow ("left today" or "left in your 30-day allowance") and roomResetNote ("midnight UTC" or "older messages leave the 30-day count"), and leaves bulkLimit empty. A refused batch that does not fit also counts as a limit hit for the follow-up emails.

templates.name: One phone on the free plan
templates.subject: To use a second phone, upgrade to Pro
templates.preheader: The free plan covers one phone. Pro covers up to {{proDeviceLimit}}.
templates.body:
# Your second phone was not added

Hi {{firstName}},

The free plan covers one active phone, and {{deviceName}} already uses it. Pro covers up to {{proDeviceLimit}} phones, so you can send from all of them, with no daily limit and {{proMonthlyLimit}} messages per rolling 30 days.

**[Upgrade to Pro]({{upgradeUrl}})**

{{proPrice}} a month, or {{proYearlyPrice}} a year ({{proYearlyMonthly}} a month).

To keep the free plan instead, turn off {{deviceName}} on the dashboard, then register the new phone.

templates.name: All phone slots in use (paid)
templates.subject: All your phone slots are in use
templates.preheader: Move to a bigger plan to add more phones.
templates.body:
# Your new phone was not added

Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan covers {{deviceLimit}} active phones, and all of them are in use. A bigger plan covers more phones, so you can add this one and spread sending across all of them.

**[See bigger plans]({{billingUrl}})**

If you need more phones than our largest plan covers, reply to this email and we will set up a custom plan. To stay on your plan instead, turn off a phone you no longer use on the dashboard.
